'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Max Mattese DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Max Mattese]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Max Maltese
* '''Deck name:''' Watto 4
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
